entities.name: Sidelink measurement object addition/modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed by the UE when adding or modifying sidelink measurement objects based on received configuration.

entities.name: sl-MeasObjectToAddModList
entities.description: List containing sidelink measurement objects to be added or modified.

entities.name: sl-MeasObjectId
entities.description: Identifier for a sidelink measurement object.

entities.name: sl-MeasObjectList
entities.description: List of configured sidelink measurement objects stored in VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: VarMeasConfigSL
entities.description: Variable storing the sidelink measurement configuration.

entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Identifier for a sidelink measurement configuration linking objects and reporting configurations.

entities.name: sl-MeasIdList
entities.description: List of sidelink measurement identifiers in VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: VarMeasReportListSL
entities.description: Variable storing sidelink measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer used for periodic sidelink measurement reporting.

entities.name: sl-TimeToTrigger
entities.description: Time-to-trigger parameter associated with sidelink measurements.

entities.name: Existing entry condition
entities.description: Condition where an entry with matching sl-MeasObjectId exists in sl-MeasObjectList.

entities.name: Measurement reporting entry removal
entities.description: Property where the UE removes measurement reporting entries for associated sl-MeasId from VarMeasReportListSL.

entities.name: Timer stop and reset
entities.description: Property where the UE stops the periodical reporting timer and resets associated information for the sl-MeasId.

entities.name: Entry reconfiguration
entities.description: Property where the UE reconfigures an existing entry with received sl-MeasObject values.

entities.name: New entry addition
entities.description: Property where the UE adds a new entry for the received sl-MeasObject to sl-MeasObjectList.

relations.description: The procedure checks if an entry with matching sl-MeasObjectId exists.
If condition is met, measurement reporting entries are removed.
If condition is met, the periodical reporting timer is stopped and reset.
If condition is met, the existing entry is reconfigured.
The procedure adds a new entry for the received sl-MeasObject.
The timer stop and reset property stops the periodical reporting timer.
The timer stop and reset property resets associated information like sl-TimeToTrigger.
